implementation_notes: Kotlin has the same allocation characteristics as Java — beware boxing of generics and lambda captures. Use JMH with the Kotlin plugin, check bytecode when a Kotlin construct is unexpectedly slow, and prefer `Sequence` only for lazy chains with real cost.
